actionable.description: TrustlessExchange._update(uint256,uint256,uint112,uint112) (Candidate.sol#161-178) performs a multiplication on the result of a division: - price1CumulativeLast += (uint256(_reserve0) * 1e18 / uint256(_reserve1)) * timeElapsed (Candidate.sol#172)

TrustlessExchange.swap(address,uint256,uint256,address) (Candidate.sol#282-318) performs a multiplication on the result of a division: - amountInWithFee = (amountIn * (FEE_DENOMINATOR - feeRate)) / FEE_DENOMINATOR (Candidate.sol#303) - amountOut = (amountInWithFee * reserveOut) / (reserveIn * FEE_DENOMINATOR + amountInWithFee) (Candidate.sol#304)

TrustlessExchange._update(uint256,uint256,uint112,uint112) (Candidate.sol#161-178) performs a multiplication on the result of a division: - price0CumulativeLast += (uint256(_reserve1) * 1e18 / uint256(_reserve0)) * timeElapsed (Candidate.sol#171)

TrustlessExchange.addLiquidity(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) (Candidate.sol#193-249) performs a multiplication on the result of a division: - amount0 = (amount1Desired * _reserve0) / _reserve1 (Candidate.sol#215) - initialLiquidity = _sqrt(amount0 * amount1) (Candidate.sol#227)

TrustlessExchange.addLiquidity(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) (Candidate.sol#193-249) performs a multiplication on the result of a division: - amount0 = (amount1Desired * _reserve0) / _reserve1 (Candidate.sol#215) - l0 = (amount0 * _totalSupply) / _reserve0 (Candidate.sol#232)
TrustlessExchange.removeLiquidity(uint256,uint256,uint256) (Candidate.sol#251-280) uses a dangerous strict equality: - amount0 == 0 || amount1 == 0 (Candidate.sol#264)
TrustlessExchange.swap(address,uint256,uint256,address) (Candidate.sol#282-318) uses a dangerous strict equality: - amountOut == 0 || amountOut < minAmountOut (Candidate.sol#306)
TrustlessExchange.swap(address,uint256,uint256,address) (Candidate.sol#282-318) uses a dangerous strict equality: - reserveIn == 0 || reserveOut == 0 (Candidate.sol#299)
